research_question: For source-native E010/PKLSA-qualified vortex carriers evolved by a preregistered finite-core filament or incompressible Euler provider, does a phase-wrap/global-phase/spatial-shift-covariant circular/Fourier spectral qualifier identify a stable low-dimensional Kelvin residual field, and if so do Sine-Gordon restoring dynamics and/or Mittag-Leffler fractional-memory relaxation survive blind discovery, held-out confirmation and numerical certification?
objective: Replace the v0.3.0 raw-phase split-POD blocking test with a preregistered circular/Fourier G2 test that respects the phase observable topology, while retaining the historical raw-POD overlap as a diagnostic only. Then apply the unchanged SG/ML model competition and certification chain using SST Falsifier Framework v1.0.6.
null_hypothesis: H0: the invariant G2 spectral criteria fail or the Sine-Gordon/Mittag-Leffler candidates fail their preregistered discovery, held-out, numerical-certification and independent-replication thresholds beyond the registered alternatives.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: at least one case passes the invariant circular/Fourier G2 qualifier and one or both candidate mechanisms outperform the registered alternatives, survive held-out and numerical certification, and replicate across eligible independent physical evidence.
assumptions: The provider freezes the phase observable before A056 model scoring; A056 does not infer a favorable phase definition after seeing outcomes.
The time and arclength-like coordinates are monotone and approximately uniform within the registered tolerance.
Python/NumPy FP64 is the reference numerical lane and C++/OpenMP FP64 is the certification lane; SYCL FP32/DD32 remains screening-only.
For conservative inviscid dynamics, a decreasing projected ringdown observable is interpreted as transfer/dephasing unless a separate dissipative mechanism is supplied.

The real-provider phase is the paired transverse Kelvin residual phase after common rigid-motion registration to the unperturbed material carrier; the seeded Fourier winding is removed before phase scoring.
The real-provider ringdown R(t) is a normalized Kelvin-mode projection amplitude in conservative dynamics and is not interpreted as thermodynamic dissipation.
Different numerical resolutions of one carrier are convergence replays, never independent replication.
The v0.3.0 filament m=3 G2 diagnostic is a development/motivation set only; it cannot supply confirmatory evidence for v0.4.0 and its raw-POD overlap values are not used to set the new thresholds.
The v0.4.0 blocking spectral representation is z(s,t)=exp(i phi(s,t)); circular POD uses per-time spatial-mean removal, and early/late Fourier comparison uses normalized non-zero-mode power.
The historical raw-phase split-POD overlap is recorded for longitudinal comparison but is non-blocking in v0.4.0.
Official v0.4.0 real-provider campaigns use the preregistered Kelvin m=4, epsilon=0.03 perturbation so the dynamic input is out-of-sample relative to the observed v0.3.0 m=3 development run.

Circular/Fourier G2 thresholds are frozen before any v0.4.0 m=4 provider run: top-3 circular POD energy fraction >=0.95, circular POD orthogonality residual <=1e-10, and early/late non-zero-mode Fourier power overlap >=0.90.

steps.operation: Verify frozen protocol/blind commitments and enumerate hashed provider cases.

Resolve and re-hash E010 v0.3.1 strict upstream-provider representatives, construct finite-core base/perturbed carriers, evolve them with the frozen provider, and commit the private carrier reveal before A056 scoring.
Validate provider metadata, array shapes, monotonicity, finite values and sampling uniformity.

Evaluate Python FP64 analytic sanity, circular-POD concentration/orthogonality, and phase-shift/spatial-shift-covariant early/late Fourier-power overlap; record raw-phase split-POD overlap as diagnostic only.
Fit Wave/Klein-Gordon/Duffing/Sine-Gordon and exponential/stretched/bi-exponential/Mittag-Leffler families on discovery blocks and evaluate BIC.
Evaluate frozen held-out temporal blocks with NRMSE ratios.
Apply deterministic coarsening diagnostics and strict C++/OpenMP FP64 parity to confirmed candidates.
Consume optional canonical-framework SYCL/DD32 smoke evidence as screening-only diagnostics.
Assess evidence-class-aware replication; synthetic/simulation controls cannot close physical cross-source replication.
Classify joint, phase-only or memory-only physical support only after eligible replication.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Sine-Gordon fails discovery Delta-BIC >= 10 or the registered held-out NRMSE-ratio threshold.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: No Sine-Gordon phase support for that case.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Mittag-Leffler fails Delta-BIC >= 10, held-out NRMSE ratio, or the support interval 0.48 < alpha < 0.97.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: No fractional-memory support for that case.

falsification_criteria.criterion: A confirmed candidate fails registered resolution convergence or strict Python-FP64/C++-FP64 parity.
Only synthetic/simulation evidence or fewer than two eligible independent physical groups support the candidate.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: Implementation/simulation support only; no physical cross-source claim.

falsification_criteria.criterion: The real E010 provider fails its numerical-validity or same-carrier cross-resolution convergence criteria.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: No real-provider A056 support may be promoted from that carrier/solver family.

falsification_criteria.criterion: No admissible case simultaneously reaches circular top-3 POD energy fraction >=0.95, circular-POD orthogonality residual <=1e-10, and non-zero-mode early/late Fourier-power overlap >=0.90.
falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: G2 FAIL: no v0.4.0 spectral qualification; SG/ML discovery is not entered for that campaign.

edge_cases: The alpha -> 1 boundary is an ordinary exponential null and cannot count as fractional memory.
A Mittag-Leffler-like tail may approximate a continuum or mixture of ordinary modes; bi-exponential competition and held-out scoring reduce but do not eliminate this identifiability risk.
Closed filament geometry can have frame/gauge ambiguities; phase_definition_id must be frozen upstream.
In inviscid conservative dynamics an apparent ringdown need not imply dissipation.
The phase is undefined if the paired transverse perturbation amplitude collapses to numerical zero; a preregistered valid-fraction floor rejects that provider case.
Rigid Kabsch registration removes translation/rotation only; scale and reflection are forbidden.
Phase is circular: adding integer multiples of 2*pi must not alter the blocking G2 representation.
A time-dependent global phase factor exp(i psi(t)) and a cyclic spatial translation may rotate complex Fourier coefficients while leaving the blocking power-spectrum comparison unchanged.
A travelling coherent mode may have a low raw split-POD overlap; therefore raw-phase and circular-POD early/late subspace overlaps are diagnostics, not blocking v0.4.0 criteria.
predictions: If Sine-Gordon closure is physical, positive a and b and held-out superiority should recur across independent provider families.
If effective fractional memory is physical, an interior alpha estimate should survive coarsening and independent physical providers.
Synthetic controls should recover implementation behavior while remaining ineligible for physical cross-source closure.

If the v0.3.0 G2 stop was primarily representation-sensitive, a fresh m=4 campaign may retain high circular energy concentration and high Fourier-power overlap even when the legacy raw-POD overlap is below its historical 0.85 reference.
If the underlying dynamics truly mix spatial Kelvin sectors, the normalized non-zero-mode Fourier-power overlap should fall below 0.90 and v0.4.0 must stop at G2.
Passing invariant G2 is only an admissibility result; Sine-Gordon and Mittag-Leffler claims still require their unchanged G3/G4/G5/G7 criteria.
